title: Code and data for: Integrating PS-InSAR and multi-source geospatial data for condition-aware building-level seismic risk assessment
description: Code, QGIS cartographic projects and public building-level result tables supporting the manuscript Integrating PS-InSAR and multi-source geospatial data for condition-aware building-level seismic risk assessment (submitted to GIScience & Remote Sensing). The release contains the hazard, InSAR-informed vulnerability (InSAR Building State Index), exposure and risk model code for 40,000 buildings in Kunming, China, the figure code, and attribute tables of the building-level results (data_release/, CC BY 4.0). Building geometries, TerraSAR-X products and raw housing prices are not included because of licence and regulatory restrictions.
